post.topic: Automating Manual Client Onboarding and Appointment Scheduling
post.headline: Stop Wasting Hours Scheduling Clients Manually
post.subline: Turn repetitive intake forms and calendar back-and-forth into an instant, automated workflow.
post.caption:
Still spending hours sending calendar links, follow-up emails, and intake forms?

When client onboarding is manual, leads drop off and your team wastes precious time on repetitive admin tasks.

AI automation fixes this instantly. Custom AI workflows can handle client scheduling, qualify leads in real-time, send automated prep materials, and update your CRM automatically.

Clinics, agencies, and service businesses can run 24/7 without adding headcount or burning out staff.
